title: EQU8 in 2021: a small kernel driver with a privileged control plane
summary: A close reading of the original EQU8 driver teardown separates sample provenance, service-to-driver control, process protection and callback telemetry. The 2021 account does not measure subsequent versions or server enforcement.
author: Observatory editorial
takeaways: The driver path and size characterize one installed sample, not every EQU8 release.
A privilege-gated device CREATE and IOCTL control path are distinct from the callback that reduces process/thread handle access.
The bounded callback log proves a reported collection path, not a ban decision or full kernel adversary coverage.
